description: In every arithmetic structure, full satisfaction of the specified Peano conjunction at any assignments is equivalent to full satisfaction of the finite second-order Peano theory.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderValidity.peanoConjunction_realize.{u_1} {M : Type u_1}
  [Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M] (a : ℕ → M)
  (r : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.RelationAssignment M) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.fullRealize a r
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderValidity.peanoConjunction ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderArithmetic.FullModels M
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderArithmetic.peanoTheory
